value.title: Session history (workstream 008 s04)
value.summary: `pij sessions --history` lists every harness session each seat has used, with its start, end, harness, model, session id, transcript location, final context size and why it changed; `pij pod sessions <pod>` lists them per member. It is read from the event log's `seat.put` facts with no new storage.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: `pij sessions --history` lists every harness session each seat has used, with its start, end, harness, model, session id, transcript location, final context size and why it changed; `pij pod sessions <pod>` lists them per member. It is read from the event log's `seat.put` facts with no new storage.

sections.name: goals
value: Cost per seat and per pod with no manual matching; a rebind storm (one seat, three sessions and three processes in nine seconds) is visible.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Pricing the tokens (the model-cost role's reports read this).

value.claim: A pure fold over a seat's `seat.put` events in order: a session starts at the first event with its session id and ends at the first with another id, or at the seat's tombstone. Why it changed comes from the events beside it: spawn.launched and spawn.bound (spawn), seat.revive-postmortem and seat.resumed (revive), a new session on the same process (rebind), the compaction rows (compact; a harness that keeps its session id across a compact shows the compact as an event inside the session).

`pij sessions --history [--seat <id>] [--limit <n>]` (default 20 sessions per seat) and `pij pod sessions <pod>` read one indexed event-log query per seat (seat, kind, seq), launch nothing and write nothing.

Context size at a session's end: the transcript location is derived from the harness and session id; pij reads at most the last 256 KiB of it (or the harness's own usage record) for the last usage figure, and shows unknown when the file is gone or the figure is not in the tail. A transcript is never read whole.
Cost: one indexed read per seat listed; at most 256 KiB read per session listed, so a default call reads at most 5 MiB per seat. In-process; no launch; nothing per tick.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: seat.put events (crates/store/src/registry.rs descriptor_event) carry the whole descriptor; indexes spine_by_seat_kind and spine_by_seat_kind_at; the event log is never pruned. Transcript reads: the session status sources (SessionStatusPort).

value.risk: A very long-lived seat has thousands of seat.put events.
value.mitigation: One indexed scan of that seat's puts; the fold keeps only changes. Measured on the live store: 203 puts for the longest-lived seat.

value.risk: A transcript's last usage line is longer than the cap.
value.mitigation: Shown as unknown, never a partial read.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Cost: one indexed read per seat; at most 256 KiB per session listed (5 MiB per seat at the default limit); no launch, loop, poll or timer.
No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
